text:
marta: Hey team — thinking we should package a small "bento" of infra artifacts for new cloud partners: 1) opinionated Terraform module (VPC, subnets, IAM), 2) Helm chart + k8s manifest for demo app, 3) CI smoke test + deploy workflow. lightweight, provider-agnostic defaults so partners can onboard fast.

sam: +1. can we make the TF module composable so partners only drop in provider blocks? avoid opinionated networking where possible.

kevin: I can own the Helm + demo app. proposal: default nginx-based echo service + a tiny proxy that exercise inference endpoints. keeps size small.

lina: for marketplace listings we also need a deploy script that runs locally for validation (mac/linux) and a one-click Cloud Console deploy for each cloud. maybe a simple cloudbuild/workflow template per provider.

marta: agree. timeline idea: RFC this week, proof-of-concept repo next week, cut first partner preview in 3 weeks. owners: sam = TF, kevin = chart/app, lina = cloud deploy templates, marta = partner docs + checklist.

sam: rough TF snippet I sketched:
```hcl
module "partner_network" {
  source = "github.com/redwood/bento-templates//terraform/net?ref=init"
  providers = { aws = aws, gcp = google }
  env = "partner-demo"
}
```

kevin: nice. for Helm values we'll expose a few toggles only: replicas, ingress, resourceClass. keep default tiny.

lina: I'll prototype a GCP Marketplace-ready Cloud Build YAML and a quick ARM template for Azure. can we standardize on a single CI job that runs `terraform init && plan` + `helm lint`?

marta: yes, single smoke CI is perfect. also add an automated security scan step (static policy check) before partner handoff.

deploy-bot: Deploy-check triggered for branch "bento/init" — smoke CI queued (plan + helm lint + snyk).

kevin: one note — documentation should include a matrix: supported regions, minimal VM/gpu sizes for inference flows, and known constraints per cloud. partners ask this first.

marta: good call. I'll draft the partner-facing README and checklist items: "what we need from you" + test creds + sample traffic profile.

sam: can we also add toggle to opt into Quantized model builds (for on-prem partners)? that affects instance sizing in the matrix.

marta: include as an advanced opt-in. for MVP keep defaults unquantized.

lina: I'll slot a 1-hour sync tomorrow to align artifacts and CI matrix. pinged calendar.

marta: perfect — owners confirmed. I'll open the repo and put an initial ISSUE_TEMPLATE + PR checklist. GH: github.com/redwood/partner-bento (wip). :rocket:
